title: Wordmark / Depth and color animation

location.extent: Representative frame; complete local motion provided

slide_intent: Preserve recognizable letterforms while changing their surrounding depth so the viewer can follow identity through a transition.
strategic_value: The short transition can connect Twitch’s simple signature with its more expressive gradient treatment.
demonstration: The white wordmark expands into colored depth on black, then resolves as a white-and-black signature on purple.
practical_value: Distinguish the stable letterform from the changing depth and background.

content_islands.name: Black-ground opening
content_islands.spec: Center the white signature and briefly expand a colored extrusion beneath it.

content_islands.name: Purple-ground resolution
content_islands.spec: Resolve to the smaller white signature with black depth on a solid purple field.

reference_purposes.Expression: The animation moves between a flat signature, gradient extrusion and a simpler purple-ground state.
